english.title: Transport undertaking fail to ensure data downloaded from driver card - data previously downloaded
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 97E(2) and 3(2) and 97G of the Transport Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
transport undertaking
controlling and using a vehicle
without reasonable excuse
failed to ensure relevant data
was downloaded from the driver card
no later than the relevant download period
required by article 10 of the Community Drivers' Hours Regulations
when the data had previously been downloaded under section 97E

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence applies to transport undertakings under the Community Drivers' Hours Regulation.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.
Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
